200.description:
Search the GTFS schedule feed catalog (`GET /v1/gtfs_feeds`) by country, state/province, municipality, provider name, official flag or bounding box, or run the catalog's full-text search (`GET /v1/search`, `q`) which ignores geographic filters. Returns feed identity, provider, locations, producer URL, licence, bounding box and the latest mirrored dataset summary, paged by limit/offset.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feed_count` | number |  |
| `feeds` | object[] |  |
| `next_offset` | number | Offset of the next page, or null when this page returned fewer items than `limit`. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total` | number | Total matches; only the full-text endpoint reports it. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Rows of one GTFS table (agency, routes, stops, trips, stop_times, shapes, calendar, calendar_dates, feed_info) for one feed, read from the agency's producer zip as published (all values text; times past 24:00 kept verbatim), paged by an opaque cursor pinned to the dataset id and the SHA-256 of the zip bytes. Every page re-fetches the zip and compares its hash with the cursor: a different file fails with `upstream_error` whose message starts with `publication_changed`. Zips over 32 MiB, feeds that need an API key, or feeds without a producer URL return an empty page with a `handoff` object (producer URL, size, posted hash) instead of rows.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `catalog_hash` | string | SHA-256 the catalog posts for the latest dataset. |
| `columns` | string[] | Header row of the table as published; empty on hand-off. |
| `content_hash` | string | SHA-256 of the producer zip bytes this page was read from. Null on hand-off. |
| `dataset_id` | string | Latest dataset id in the catalog at call time. |
| `feed_id` | string |  |
| `handoff` | object |  |
| `next_cursor` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `offset` | number |  |
| `producer_url` | string |  |
| `publication_id` | string | The dataset id when the fetched zip's SHA-256 equals the catalog's latest dataset hash; otherwise `<feed_id>-producer-<sha256 prefix>` because the agency has republished since the catalog mirrored it. Null on hand-off. |
| `record_count` | number | Rows on this page. |
| `records` | object[] |  |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `table` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Cheap version check for one GTFS feed (`GET /v1/gtfs_feeds/{id}` and `/datasets?latest=true`): the latest mirrored dataset id (publication id), when it was downloaded, the catalog's posted SHA-256 and MD5 of the zip, zipped and unzipped size, service window, bounding box and validation summary, plus the producer file URL and whether rows can be read from it (hand-off when the zip is over 32 MiB or needs an API key).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agency_timezone` | string |  |
| `authentication_type` | number |  |
| `bounding_box` | object |  |
| `content_hash` | string | SHA-256 of the dataset zip as posted by the catalog. |
| `feed_id` | string |  |
| `feed_name` | string |  |
| `file_url` | string | The agency's producer URL (source_info.producer_url); the file records_list reads. |
| `handoff_reason` | string | Why rows are handed off instead of read (no producer URL, needs API key, zip over 32 MiB, no dataset); null when readable. |
| `has_dataset` | boolean | False when the catalog has never mirrored a dataset for this feed; the dataset fields are then null. |
| `hash_md5` | string |  |
| `hosted_url` | string | Mirror URL, reference only (robots-disallowed host). |
| `is_official` | boolean |  |
| `license_url` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `provider` | string |  |
| `publication_id` | string | Latest dataset id, e.g. mdb-292-202607090048. |
| `published_at` | string | When MobilityData downloaded the dataset (downloaded_at). |
| `readable` | boolean | True when records_list can read rows from the producer zip: a producer URL exists, authentication_type is 0 and the zipped size is at most 32 MiB. |
| `record_count` | object | Not known without opening the zip; always null here. |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `service_date_range_end` | string |  |
| `service_date_range_start` | string |  |
| `source_record_id` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `status` | string |  |
| `unzipped_folder_size_mb` | number |  |
| `validation_report` | object |  |
| `zipped_folder_size_mb` | number |  |
